brand.name: Saffron Hearth Kitchen
brand.what: an invented family-run Middle Eastern and North African grill and bakery in Toronto: charcoal grill, fresh flatbread from a clay oven, slow-cooked lamb and chicken, mint tea
brand.audience: families and friends looking for a warm sit-down meal or catering

idea: Fire and bread. Kinetic close-ups of flatbread puffing in the clay oven, skewers hitting the charcoal with a flare, spices falling in slow motion, a family table filling up, laughter, mint tea poured from height. End on the whole family table.

end_card.line: Fire, bread, and a table for everyone.

notes: No alcohol and no pork anywhere on screen. Modest wardrobe. Invented business, no real people.
